Issue_Description: Gross specific CO2 (618.17 kg CO2/t) vs GCCA Net specific CO2 (556 kg CO2/t).
Root_Cause_in_Indian_Reporting: GCCA cement protocols subtract alternative fuel emissions and calcination offsets in Net figures.
Impact_on_Scope3_Estimation: High: Understates emissions by 10.1% if Net figure is applied naively.
Methodological_Mitigation_in_Scope3Track: Adopt Gross GHG Intensity (618.17 kg CO2/t) as the primary conservative Scope 3 factor.
Audit_Recommendation_for_Platform: Display transparent toggle in Scope3Track between Gross and Net clinker emission factors.

Issue_Description: Captive thermal coal plant emissions aggregated with alumina refinery process heat.
Root_Cause_in_Indian_Reporting: Severe co-location of coal mining, bauxite refining, and smelter power generation in single industrial complexes.
Impact_on_Scope3_Estimation: Medium: Distorts product-level carbon footprint across aluminium vs alumina vs copper.
Methodological_Mitigation_in_Scope3Track: Utilize Hindalco's audited aluminium intensity (19.39 tCO2e/MT) rather than dividing total corporate emissions by total tonnage.
Audit_Recommendation_for_Platform: Require product-specific life cycle boundary declarations from multi-product metals conglomerates.

Issue_Description: Biogenic carbon from biomass co-firing reported in footnotes (38,167 tCO2e) outside Scope 1.
Root_Cause_in_Indian_Reporting: SEBI BRSR format requests biogenic emissions as a separate memo item under Principle 6.
Impact_on_Scope3_Estimation: Low: Omitting biogenic carbon causes marginal discrepancies in gross energy balance.
Methodological_Mitigation_in_Scope3Track: Classify biogenic carbon in separate metadata field; follow GHG Protocol Corporate Standard treating biogenic CO2 as memo item.
Audit_Recommendation_for_Platform: Implement explicit biogenic carbon badge in evidence inspection view.

Issue_Description: 61.9% of thermal energy derived from black liquor and biomass; Scope 1 fossil emissions appear abnormally low.
Root_Cause_in_Indian_Reporting: Integrated Kraft pulping cycles burn black liquor recovery solids for co-generation.
Impact_on_Scope3_Estimation: High: Standard spend-based EEIO factors severely overestimate paper emissions by assuming coal-heavy grid.
Methodological_Mitigation_in_Scope3Track: Mandate supplier-specific activity calculations for integrated paper mills to reward biogenic/renewable thermal generation.
Audit_Recommendation_for_Platform: Flag paper purchases with substantial biomass share for supplier-specific method rather than spend-based fallback.

Issue_Description: Supreme reports low Scope 1+2 converting intensity (0.386 t/MT) because raw polymer resins are purchased externally.
Root_Cause_in_Indian_Reporting: Plastic converters perform mechanical shaping and extrusion; resin synthesis emissions reside in resin supplier upstream Scope 1.
Impact_on_Scope3_Estimation: High: If manufacturer treats Supreme's plastic as raw material, upstream polymer resin (2.0-2.8 tCO2/t) must be accounted.
Methodological_Mitigation_in_Scope3Track: Scope3Track must account for Scope 3 upstream Category 1 cradle-to-gate resin footprint in product factor mode.
Audit_Recommendation_for_Platform: Enable cradle-to-gate vs gate-to-gate configuration switches for converted plastic components.

Issue_Description: Physical output reported in Megawatts (MW) electrical rating rather than uniform metric tonnes.
Root_Cause_in_Indian_Reporting: Capital machinery has extreme product heterogeneity (boilers, turbines, transformers, pumps).
Impact_on_Scope3_Estimation: High: Prevents simple mass-based activity emission factor application.
Methodological_Mitigation_in_Scope3Track: Support multi-modal activity units: Units (per machine), MW capacity, and monetary spend-based fallback.
Audit_Recommendation_for_Platform: Establish machinery equipment weight profiles in Category 2 calculation engine.

Issue_Description: CEA publishes official national grid emission factor reports with a 9 to 12 month lag (e.g. v20 released Dec 2024 for FY24).
Root_Cause_in_Indian_Reporting: Consolidation of hourly generation and auxiliary consumption data across all state and central utilities takes 9 months.
Impact_on_Scope3_Estimation: Medium: Reporting year emissions must temporarily utilize previous year factor or provisional updates.
Methodological_Mitigation_in_Scope3Track: Maintain versioned grid factor tables (v19 for FY23, v20 for FY24) with automated vintage matching based on reporting month.
Audit_Recommendation_for_Platform: Store grid factor vintage metadata inside every calculation receipt.

Issue_Description: Cornerstone factors are denominated in 2024 USD; converting to INR with arbitrary deflators induces unverified distortion.
Root_Cause_in_Indian_Reporting: Exchange rate fluctuations between INR and USD distort real physical emissions.
Impact_on_Scope3_Estimation: Medium: An INR depreciation appears as artificial decarbonization in spend-based Scope 3 estimations.
Methodological_Mitigation_in_Scope3Track: Preserve original published USD factors; apply direct RBI annual average exchange rate without speculative price-deflator adjustments.
Audit_Recommendation_for_Platform: Log currency conversion rate and base year in every spend-based calculation receipt.

Issue_Description: Both entities explicitly state 'No independent assessment/assurance has been carried out by an external agency' in their FY24 BRSRs.
Root_Cause_in_Indian_Reporting: SEBI permitted phased adoption of reasonable assurance for companies outside top 150 market cap in FY24.
Impact_on_Scope3_Estimation: Medium: Increases uncertainty of self-reported energy and emissions figures.
Methodological_Mitigation_in_Scope3Track: Reflect lower assurance score in candidate selection rubric; flag supplier as Self-Certified in Scope3Track UI.
Audit_Recommendation_for_Platform: Encourage suppliers to upload statutory auditor verification certificates.

Issue_Description: 5 out of 10 companies saw specific emission intensity INCREASE or remain flat YoY, contrary to general decarbonization claims.
Root_Cause_in_Indian_Reporting: Industrial ramp-ups, trial runs (e.g. Hindalco potlines), and float process emission additions increased intensities.
Impact_on_Scope3_Estimation: High: Demonstrates that corporate emissions do not monotonically decline.
Methodological_Mitigation_in_Scope3Track: Recalculate exact YoY variances using published numbers; eliminate claims of universal emissions reductions.
Audit_Recommendation_for_Platform: Ensure Scope3Track reflects authentic empirical trends without artificial smoothing.
